items.statement: Core is the only source of legal and labor knowledge.
POS is the only operational governance layer.
Blueprint System only defines how assets are built.
Configuration must be preferred over code for recurring behavior.
Every fact and decision must have a single source of truth.
Each layer must own a coherent responsibility.
Architecture must support large asset growth without redesign.
Repeated work must become a repeatable protocol.
Protected runtime and production boundaries must remain explicit.
Every future change must pass Testing.
Every future change must pass Validation.
Rollback must be available before operational change.
No legal rule belongs to Blueprint System.
No operational rule belongs to Core.
Every operational decision must respect the Constitution.

notes: Principles are stable and should change only through explicit governance.
